name: Sarbani Chakravarti

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sarbani Chakravarti is an educator, poet and prose writer. Her IPPL Journal biography records postgraduate study in English and business administration, alongside teaching in Kolkata. She contributes poetry and literary criticism, and her fiction is included in “The Virasat Anthology of Short Stories”, edited by Nishi Pulugurtha and published by Blue Pencil.

In “Circumspection”, fear is asked to guard a deserted castle against hope. Darkness offers a troubling refuge, while light promises movement but also exhaustion and collapse. The poem reverses the usual comfort of hopeful imagery, allowing its guarded speaker to expose the cost of both expectation and withdrawal.
